title: Java Code Intelligence graph record (v1)
description: One line of analyzer NDJSON output. The first line is always a snapshot record. Contract rule: within major version 1, fields may be added but never removed or re-typed.

resolution.description: CONFIRMED = compiler binding to exactly one declaration. FRAMEWORK_DERIVED = derived by a documented rule (Spring bean resolution, annotation semantics, single implementation, Lombok synthesis). AMBIGUOUS = several candidates, all listed in attrs.candidates. UNRESOLVED = target unknown, reason in attrs.reason.

nodeKind.description: 1.1.0 added DATABASE_PROCEDURE, CONFIG_PROPERTY. 1.2.0 added the front-end kinds UI_COMPONENT (.vue file), UI_MODULE (JS/TS file), UI_STORE (Pinia store file), UI_FUNCTION, UI_ROUTE (vue-router record), UI_HTTP_CALL (HTTP client call site). Values are only ever added within major version 1.

edgeKind.description: 1.1.0 added ACCEPTS/RETURNS (endpoint -> contract type), USES_TYPE (method -> type), HAS_FIELD_TYPE (type -> field type), THROWS (method -> exception type), CALLS_EXTERNAL (method -> EXTERNAL_API), INVOKES_PROCEDURE (SQL -> procedure), READS_CONFIG (type/method -> CONFIG_PROPERTY), SCHEDULES (scheduler call site -> job method), TRIGGERS (EVENT -> listener). PUBLISHES is method -> EVENT. 1.2.0 added CONTAINS (UI file -> UI_FUNCTION), IMPORTS (UI file -> UI file), RENDERS (component -> child component), ROUTES_TO (UI_ROUTE -> component), MAKES_HTTP_CALL (UI_FUNCTION -> UI_HTTP_CALL), CALLS_API (UI_HTTP_CALL -> API_ENDPOINT, cross-repository, added by server combine). System snapshots list their repositories in scope.repos [{repoId, role, repoPath, commitSha, pathPrefix}]; file paths of non-primary repositories start with pathPrefix ('@<repoId>/').

rule.description: Analyzer rule that produced the fact, e.g. BINDING, CHA_SINGLE_IMPL, QUALIFIER.

commitSha.description: Full git SHA, or nogit-<sha256 prefix> for non-git sources.

inScope.description: False for referenced nodes outside the analysed packages (outgoing edges not extracted).
